blocks.text: Yes. Cyberpunk is reality now — not the neon, the condition: algorithms deciding who gets seen, who gets paid, who gets erased, a future that arrived on schedule but forgot to invite everyone. Rabbit Hole Paradox is where the work lives, and it's growing: books and essays already out, YouTube and podcasts coming, more titles — free and commercial — in the pipeline. An ecosystem, not a feed, meant to grow outward in every direction, chrome and moss on the same page.

Four independent blogs, one frequency, none of them merging or diluting. Some knowledge stays free forever — the Post-Labor Economics books are proof of that — while the rest pays its own way, because the ecosystem needs both roots and fruit. No corporate landlord on the newsletter, no platform doing the resisting for us. You're not lost. You're exactly where the paradox wanted you.
